rationale: A compact applied set covers data types and initialization, operator tracing, precedence, a formula and output, conditional design, threshold boundaries, and control-flow comparison.

coverage.M2L1-E01: choose and classify values by type
coverage.M2L1-E02: trace augmented assignments and explain initialization
coverage.M2L1-E04: show and apply multi-level operator precedence
coverage.M2L1-E05: apply a formula and describe formatted output
coverage.M2L1-E06: design and justify a compound conditional
coverage.M2L1-E07: design a branch chain and test boundary values
coverage.M2L1-E08: compare conditional structures and control flow
